title: After-sale Service
simplified_paragraphs: A：我的手机才用一个星期，就坏了。我要退货！
B：真抱歉，给您带来不便。但是，如果您要退换货，您必须先给我看看小票和发票，您带了吗？
B：是的。别担心，我们的产品一般不会出很大的毛病。我们可以帮您修理。
A：不用了。我对这个手机感到很不满意。我要买其他公司的手机。
traditional_paragraphs: A：我的手機才用一個星期，就壞了。我要退貨！
B：真抱歉，給您帶來不便。但是，如果您要退換貨，您必須先給我看看小票和發票，您帶了嗎？
B：是的。別擔心，我們的產品一般不會出很大的毛病。我們可以幫您修理。
A：不用了。我對這個手機感到很不滿意。我要買其他公司的手機。
pinyin_paragraphs: A： wǒ de shǒu jī cái yòng yī gè xīng qī， jiù huài le。 wǒ yào tuì huò！
B： zhēn bào qiàn， gěi nín dài lái bù biàn。 dàn shì， rú guǒ nín yào tuì huàn huò， nín bì xū xiān gěi wǒ kàn kan xiǎo piào hé fā piào， nín dài le ma？
A： shì zhè liǎng zhāng ma？
B： shì de。 bié dān xīn， woměn de chǎn pǐn yī bān bù huì chū hěn dà de máo bìng。 wǒ men kě yǐ bāng nín xiū lǐ。
A： bù yòng le。 wǒ duì zhè gè shǒu jī gǎn dào hěn bù mǎn yì。 wǒ yào mǎi qí tā gōng sī de shǒu jī。
english_paragraphs: A: I've only had this phone for a week, and it's already broken. I want to return it!
B: I'm very sorry for the inconvenience. But if you'd like to return or exchange it, I'll need to see your receipt and invoice first. Do you have them with you?
A: Are these the two documents?
B: Yes. Don't worry—our products generally don't have major problems. We can repair it for you.
A: No, thanks. I'm very unhappy with this phone. I'm going to buy one from another company.
english_full:
A: I've only had this phone for a week, and it's already broken. I want to return it!

B: I'm very sorry for the inconvenience. But if you'd like to return or exchange it, I'll need to see your receipt and invoice first. Do you have them with you?

A: Are these the two documents?

B: Yes. Don't worry—our products generally don't have major problems. We can repair it for you.

A: No, thanks. I'm very unhappy with this phone. I'm going to buy one from another company.
